invariants.rationale: Method cannot operate on a null list; usually, methods processing collections expect non-null input.
The consumer must be valid and non-null to be used inside the foreach operation.
Parallelism should be at least 1, as non-positive values would not make sense for task execution.
By type signature, data is a List, which must hold at method entry.
By type signature, consumer is a SerializableConsumer, which must hold at entry.
